svg.text: All logic 3.3 V. One I2S port shared by the mic and both DACs, one I2C bus for OLED, IMU and ToF. Wire colour = signal.
port hole on the label side faces out
bridges: FLT L, DEMP L, XSMT H, FMT L
GAIN floating, + / - to a 4 ohm speaker
ADC1 only, ADC2 dies with WiFi
DOUT: I2S data to DACs GP9
DIN: I2S data from mic GP10
docs/pinmap.md is the source of truth; firmware/main/pins.h must match
